pluginText.pf.visit: {"check_in":"the check-in code at the counter at the fitting; a walk-in drop-off is checked in at the counter at once; at a house call, the code at the door","intake":"a ticket per garment: its condition with photos, the pins and chalk marks, and the date it's needed by","estimate":"written, item by item, before any work; the customer says yes to all, to some items, or not today; good for 7 days","added_work":"anything new found while sewing is texted with its price; nothing extra without a yes; no answer in 2 days: it's left for the next fitting","second_fitting":"a second fitting checks the fit; one more adjustment is included","status_words":["IN","IN WORK","WAITING ON A YES","READY"],"ready":"READY texts the pick-up hours, anything due and the held-until date","pick_up":"the final fitting is the pick-up: a try-on in the garment with the shoes, and how a bustle hooks; handed over once paid","done_proof":"the fitting's code checks the visit in; READY and the pick-up close it","late":"more than 15 minutes late: a shorter fitting, or the next open time","house_call":"the tailor fits and pins at the home; the clothes go to the shop and come back on a booked return, with a try-on"}
pluginText.pf.money: {"before":"nothing taken at the shop: fittings are free, and a missed or cancelled fitting has no fee","deposit":"50% for bridal work and jobs over $200, paid when the written price is OK'd at the fitting; deposit cap: from the state form","after":"the rest at the counter at pick-up; or the bill Rosie texts at pick-up, for a Saturday morning","house_call":"the $89 house-call fee held; the bill after the clothes come back","rush":"+30% on every item when needed within 4 weeks, inside the first price","cancel_after_ok":"the deposit back, less work already done; money kept: from the state form","storage":"finished items held 90 days after READY; no storage fee to start","materials":"lace, zippers or buttons bought for a job are added at cost, with a yes first","tips":"no tip line","tax":"the shop's tax rate, where the state taxes the work","rosfield_2":"Rosfield's $2 per confirmed booking applies"}
pluginText.pf.messages: {"never_in_text":["Body measurements","A photo of the customer in the garment","A gate or door code"],"languages":"English and Spanish","minors":"texts about a child's or a teen's clothes go to the parent who booked"}
pluginText.pf.staff: {"skills":["alterations","bridal","suits","repairs","house calls","makeup"],"licenses":"none for tailoring; a makeup license for makeup work, where the state's rules require one","supervision":"none","who_oks":"the owner OKs bridal prices, prices over $200, rush work within 10 days and any fee","stand_in":"a hem or a repair: any tailor; bridal fittings: only the master tailor"}
pluginText.pf.rules: {"written_price":"switch: a written price before work, above an amount: from the state form; the shop writes every item anyway","fees_in_first_price":"switch: every required fee, like a rush fee, inside the first price: from the state form","money_kept_on_cancel":"switch: what may be kept when a customer cancels after OK'ing the price: from the state form","unclaimed_items":"switch: how long finished items are held, the written notice, and the waiting time before they're given away or sold: from the state form; the owner decides, and Rosie sends only the notices the owner OKs","right_to_cancel_at_home":"switch: a right to cancel work sold at the customer's home: from the state form","records":"7 years"}
pluginText.pf.edges: {"applies":["A no-show or a late cancel: no fee at the shop; at a house call, up to the $89 held, only if Sam confirms","More than 15 minutes late: a shorter fitting, or the next open time","Needed too soon: the rush price, or the owner's OK within 10 days","Yes to some items only","More work found while the garment is in, with no answer","Still not right at the second fitting: one more adjustment, included","The garment isn't picked up","A garment damaged at the shop","A fix asked before the event"],"handling":"each the generic way, with the plug-in's words; the owner confirms every fee"}
